theme: Website navigation, themed findings and dated research record
question: Can readers reach a main result in two links and find recent work while retaining all existing site URLs and publication gates?
outcome: Seven navigation entries group the existing pages. Findings reads the shared theme guide with a recorded area fallback and retains unlisted cards. Home lists ten recent attempts and counts conjectures. The complete registry is ordered newest first and grouped by date. Explore describes both existing viewers. The living atlas remains off Explore because its optional street tiles are external resources.
challenge: Shared working-tree inputs changed during development; CRLF input broke the first viewer-description extraction; tmp is a junction to the excluded D: storage; the atlas has an optional remote tile loader.
remedy: Preserved the committed baseline and tested the guide contract in an in-memory fixture. Normalized the description input to LF. Used ignored _site directories. Replayed a cached Git-selected snapshot for deterministic output. Kept the resource gate and added tile-loader recognition to the checker.
retry_when: A source guide changes format, a publication check fails, or a reviewed offline atlas bundle becomes available. Rebuild the committed source and review before publishing.
